cur-fossil-pindai.dateNote: In 1987 Jean-Christophe Balouet and Eric Buffetaut named Mekosuchus, a small land crocodile, from bones in the Pindai Caves on the west coast of New Caledonia. The caves also hold Sylviornis, a giant flightless bird. The bones are from the last few tens of thousands of years (under 0.05 million years). Wikidata pins the caves at a rounded point.
cur-fossil-pindai.summary: Caves in New Caledonia with bones of a land crocodile and a giant flightless bird.
